name: EPIC 206044110
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 7.0 solar radii and 0.88 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206044110 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM radius (solar radii) 6.974505 (16th-84th percentiles 6.806055-7.203361), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 2,437 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.88 solar masses and 7.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,692 K at its surface.
